name: What kind of maintenance is required after original trim restoration?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required after original trim restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: After original trim restoration, ongoing maintenance is crucial to preserve its renewed condition. For interior trim, this typically involves regular dusting and occasional cleaning with mild, non-abrasive cleaners. For exterior trim, inspect it annually for any signs of wear, cracking, or peeling, especially after harsh weather in the Treasure Valley. Reapplying protective finishes, such as a fresh coat of paint or stain, every few years can significantly extend the life and appearance of the restoration. This proactive maintenance helps avoid future extensive repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: After trim restoration, maintain interior trim with regular cleaning. Annually inspect exterior trim for wear, reapplying protective finishes every few years to extend its life.
